components.gap: The source's argument for the status of its axioms is incomplete: Merin's p. 271 support for POP-D as mandatory (Steel 2003: POP-D argued necessary for enumerative induction from proportions of favorable outcomes), his normative caveat that intuitions on single axioms have limited normative value, the characterization of LIK-D as the Law of Likelihood that feels less compelling than POP-D, and the provenance of MCIE (Good 1960; Heckerman 1988) are absent (no occurrence of Steel, Good or Heckerman in rationality-4-3.tex; lines 339-343 state only that Merin finds POP-D attractive). Lines 9-10 claim to follow the complete chapter including its twenty notes, but note 1 (the analysis could be carried out in other credence representations), note 5 (counterfactual 'would have had' likelihood glosses), note 8 (Carnap's name 'relevance quotient' versus 'probability ratio measure'), note 11 (Crupi-Tentori's names for the four axioms), notes 12-13 (Steel's only-if parts; other POP-D measures and the Crupi-Tentori 2013 uniqueness result for Z), note 17 (Festa-Cevolani Matthew properties) and note 20 (application to natural-language function words, Merin 1999) have no reconstruction at the lines that cite them (e.g. 131, 154, 175, 261, 353).

components.gap: The chapter compares itself with Bayesian model comparison (lines 274-281), the P18 detection theorem and the P19 conjunction chapters (lines 497-504, 542-553), but not with the handbook's own Carnap relevance unit on the same P15 route: carnap-confirmation-relevance-and-reliability.tex lines 115-150 (sec:p15-carnap-relevance) define Carnap's relevance quotient and evidence-relative signed relevance measure r(i,h,e), with Carnap's D65-1d convention that contradictory evidence is irrelevant. rationality-4-3.tex lines 444-446 introduce Carnap's covariance measure R_C, and lines 46-58 a Carnap-modified extreme positivity, with no cross-reference and no statement of the material differences (unconditional covariance versus evidence-relative determinant; Merin's P(A)=0 neutrality versus Carnap's contradiction convention; Merin's note-8 naming of the quotient). The Hempel confirmation chapter points to sec:p15-r43-rankings, but this unit does not itself preserve Hempel's objection that the Hosiasson-Lindenbaum numerical imbalance is not fixed by logic.
